newsitem.title: CHINA: CASIL Telecom seen in HK$150 mln float - sources.
newsitem.headline: CASIL Telecom seen in HK$150 mln float - sources.

text.p: CASIL Telecommunications Holdings Ltd, a unit of China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd, is expected to raise HK$150 million in a public offer to be held later in July, market sources said on Tuesday.

Sources said the company was expected to issue 150 million new shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$1.00 each in a share float, but no further listing details were immediately available to the market.
Last month, China Aerospace said the Hong Kong Stock Exchange had in principle approved its application for a proposed spinoff of its telecommunications unit.

China Aerospace proposed to spinoff its telelcommunications equipment manufacturing and global positioning systems operation by means of a separate listing of its newly formed subsidiary, CASIL Telecommunications.
